age_policy: Completed years on query date (local machine date by default); birthday included, leap-day birthdays turn a year older on March 1 in non-leap years. A supplied age date does not update salary/team/tax snapshots.
source_note: Hupu bilingual rosters and profile/draft pages, with NBA profiles and Wikidata supplements. Identity mapped by existing stable-ID name registry. Birth dates are sourced public facts, not a guarantee every third-party record is error-free. Source roster salary/team data are not imported.
